info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Utility Billing Disputes-v5-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Dispute Listing API allows users to retrieve a comprehensive list of disputes related to utility billing. This endpoint is essential for stakeholders to track, manage, and resolve billing discrepancies effectively. Typical users include customer service representatives and billing analysts who require insights into ongoing disputes. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance customer satisfaction by providing timely updates and resolutions to billing inquiries.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details regarding disputes in billing. You can access specific information related to disputes raised by customers and their current status.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving billing dispute information. This request should conform to the predefined schema and include necessary parameters to successfully fetch the desired billing dispute details.

201.description: The dispute record was created successfully.

ListUtilityBillingDisputesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to billing disputes. The expected format is a string.

status.description: Indicates whether the request was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for tracking the dispute.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the dispute operation.

state.description: The current state of the billing dispute.

processingTimeMs.description: The time, in milliseconds, taken to process the request.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the dispute response.

ListUtilityBillingDisputesResponse_201.description: Schema representing the response for the billing dispute operation.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the dispute.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the dispute was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the dispute was created automatically by the system.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing audit information related to the dispute operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
